317	/****************************************************************************
318	 * Demo GATT service
319	 *
320	 * A minimal "transparent UART" service so a phone or PC can exercise the BLE
321	 * data path: the central writes bytes to the RX characteristic (central ->
322	 * board), the board logs them, and -- if the peer has subscribed -- echoes
323	 * them back through a TX notification (board -> central).  16-bit UUIDs in
324	 * the 0xffe0 vendor range, following the SDK app_blue_courier_link server
325	 * model: the write is handled straight from the GATT server callback (which
326	 * runs on the vendor BLE task) and the echo notification is issued from that
327	 * same context, so the demo never re-enters the stack from a foreign task or
328	 * work queue.
329	 *
330	 * Note: the write path is validated with write-without-response (a write
331	 * command).  The prebuilt vendor controller does not reliably complete a
332	 * write-request (write-with-response) or the CCCD subscribe that a Linux
333	 * BlueZ host issues, so notifications are best exercised from a phone app
334	 * such as nRF Connect.  See the board documentation.

337	#define GD32_BLE_SVC_UUID     0xffe0
338	#define GD32_BLE_RX_UUID      0xffe1   /* central -> board (write)  */
339	#define GD32_BLE_TX_UUID      0xffe2   /* board -> central (notify) */
340	#define GD32_BLE_GATT_MAXLEN  244
341	
342	enum
343	{
344	  GD32_BLE_IDX_SVC,
345	  GD32_BLE_IDX_CHAR_RX,
346	  GD32_BLE_IDX_RX,
347	  GD32_BLE_IDX_CHAR_TX,
348	  GD32_BLE_IDX_TX,
349	  GD32_BLE_IDX_TX_CCCD,
350	  GD32_BLE_IDX_NUM
351	};

353	static const ble_gatt_attr_desc_t g_gatt_db[GD32_BLE_IDX_NUM] =
354	{
355	  [GD32_BLE_IDX_SVC]     = { UUID_16BIT_TO_ARRAY(BLE_GATT_DECL_PRIMARY_SERVICE),
356	                             PROP(RD), 0 },
357	  [GD32_BLE_IDX_CHAR_RX] = { UUID_16BIT_TO_ARRAY(BLE_GATT_DECL_CHARACTERISTIC),
358	                             PROP(RD), 0 },
359	  [GD32_BLE_IDX_RX]      = { UUID_16BIT_TO_ARRAY(GD32_BLE_RX_UUID),
360	                             PROP(WR) | PROP(WC), GD32_BLE_GATT_MAXLEN },
361	  [GD32_BLE_IDX_CHAR_TX] = { UUID_16BIT_TO_ARRAY(BLE_GATT_DECL_CHARACTERISTIC),
362	                             PROP(RD), 0 },
363	  [GD32_BLE_IDX_TX]      = { UUID_16BIT_TO_ARRAY(GD32_BLE_TX_UUID),
364	                             PROP(NTF), GD32_BLE_GATT_MAXLEN },
365	  [GD32_BLE_IDX_TX_CCCD] = { UUID_16BIT_TO_ARRAY(BLE_GATT_DESC_CLIENT_CHAR_CFG),
366	                             PROP(RD) | PROP(WR),
367	                             OPT(NO_OFFSET) | sizeof(uint16_t) },
368	};
369	
370	static uint8_t  g_gatt_svc_id;
371	static uint16_t g_gatt_tx_cccd;   /* != 0 once the peer enables notifications */
372	
373	/****************************************************************************
374	 * Name: gd32_ble_gatts_cb
375	 *
376	 * Description:
377	 *   Server events.  A write to the RX characteristic is logged and echoed
378	 *   back through a TX notification; a write to the TX client-config
379	 *   descriptor toggles notifications.  No explicit read/write confirm is
380	 *   used: the stack auto-confirms from the callback return value and serves
381	 *   descriptor reads from its own storage (SDK courier_link model).
382	 *
383	 ****************************************************************************/
384	
385	static ble_status_t gd32_ble_gatts_cb(ble_gatts_msg_info_t *info)
386	{
387	  ble_gatts_op_info_t *op;
388	  ble_gatts_write_req_t *w;
389	
390	  if (info->srv_msg_type != BLE_SRV_EVT_GATT_OPERATION)
391	    {
392	      return BLE_ERR_NO_ERROR;
393	    }
394	
395	  op = &info->msg_data.gatts_op_info;
396	
397	  if (op->gatts_op_sub_evt != BLE_SRV_EVT_WRITE_REQ)
398	    {
399	      return BLE_ERR_NO_ERROR;
400	    }
401	
402	  w = &op->gatts_op_data.write_req;
403	
404	  if (w->att_idx == GD32_BLE_IDX_RX)
405	    {
406	      syslog(LOG_INFO, "BLE RX (%u): %.*s\n", w->val_len,
407	             (int)w->val_len, (const char *)w->p_val);
408	
409	      /* Echo the bytes straight back through a TX notification, from this
410	       * same BLE-task context, if the peer has subscribed.
411	       */
412	
413	      if (g_gatt_tx_cccd != 0)
414	        {
415	          ble_gatts_ntf_ind_send(op->conn_idx, g_gatt_svc_id,
416	                                 GD32_BLE_IDX_TX, w->p_val, w->val_len,
417	                                 BLE_GATT_NOTIFY);
418	        }
419	    }
420	  else if (w->att_idx == GD32_BLE_IDX_TX_CCCD &&
421	           w->val_len == sizeof(uint16_t))
422	    {
423	      g_gatt_tx_cccd = (uint16_t)(w->p_val[0] | (w->p_val[1] << 8));
424	    }
425	
426	  return BLE_ERR_NO_ERROR;
427	}

Looking at the most likely culprits for why nRF Connect can't detect the device, the SDK path configuration stands out as a potential issue—if that's pointing to the wrong location, the BLE library headers won't be found during the build. The BLE task stack size of 1024 words seems tight for the full protocol stack, and if WiFi fails to initialize first, the BLE stack won't have the platform setup it needs to function. The coexistence configuration also depends on whether both WiFi and BLE are properly enabled together.

Actually, thinking through the most probable scenario: the build probably succeeded since the user is asking about runtime behavior, which means the SDK path was correct at compile time. So the real issue is likely happening when the device actually runs. The BLE initialization depends on WiFi being up first, and if that doesn't happen cleanly or if the task stacks overflow, the BLE advertising won't start properly and nRF Connect won't see the device. The WiFi initialization is also setting up a bunch of hardware components like the system clock, DMA, and RF power, which BLE depends on. I'm also noticing the stack allocations—NuttX's interrupt stack is 2048 bytes, and BLE uses two task stacks of 4096 bytes each, which might be tight depending on what the BLE operations require.

Now I'm looking at the actual problem: nRF Connect isn't finding the device. This could be a build issue where BLE didn't compile in, a runtime crash during initialization, BLE starting but advertising failing, the device being undiscoverable, or a radio problem. The most likely culprits are the experimental flag not being set, a missing SDK path causing build failures, stack overflows during BLE startup, WiFi failing and blocking BLE, or advertising parameters being incorrect. I should also check if the board's bringup function is actually being called—if the board late init is disabled, BLE might never start at all.

现在我对完整的初始化流程有了清晰的理解。让我总结分析结果：

---

## nRF Connect 搜不到 BLE 设备的原因分析

### 📋 初始化流程梳理

```
gdwifi_start()          ← WiFi 先初始化平台（时钟、RF、NVDS）
  └→ gd32_ble_initialize()   ← BLE 依赖 WiFi 的平台初始化
       └→ ble_power_on() → ble_sw_init() → 注册回调 → ble_irq_enable()
            └→ gd32_ble_adp_evt_handler (ENABLE_CMPL_INFO)
                 └→ gd32_ble_adv_create()
                      └→ gd32_ble_adv_evt_handler (STATE_CREATE)
                           └→ gd32_ble_adv_start() → 设备开始广播
```

### 🔍 最可能的原因（按概率排序）

#### 1. **`CONFIG_BOARD_LATE_INITIALIZE` 未启用** ⚠️

在 `common/defconfig:63` 中：
```
# CONFIG_BOARD_LATE_INITIALIZE=y    ← 被注释掉了！
```

虽然 `board_app_initialize()` 有替代路径会调用 `gd32_bringup()`，但需要确认 `CONFIG_BOARDCTL=y` 是否被设置。如果 `boardctl()` 从未被 NSH 触发，BLE 初始化**根本不会执行**。

#### 2. **BLE 任务栈可能溢出**

`gd32_ble.c:112-115` 中定义：
```c
#define GD32_BLE_TASK_STACK      1024   // 1024 words = 4096 bytes
#define GD32_BLE_APP_TASK_STACK  1024   // 1024 words = 4096 bytes
```
这些是 FreeRTOS 风格的 **words** 单位。vendor 的 BLE host（GAP/GATT/SMP 全在 blob 里）在 4KB 栈上可能不够用，栈溢出会导致 BLE 任务静默崩溃。

#### 3. **WiFi 初始化失败导致 BLE 无法启动**

`gd32_bringup.c:138-142` 中：
```c
if (gdwifi_start() != 0)
  ferr("ERROR: failed to start Wi-Fi\n");
  // 但没有 return！BLE 初始化仍然会继续执行
```
如果 WiFi 初始化失败（比如 NVDS flash 初始化失败），BLE 调用 `ble_power_on()` 时平台状态不正确，可能导致 BLE 静默失败。

#### 4. **`ble_sw_init()` 可能返回错误但被忽略**

`gd32_ble.c:505-510` 中：
```c
status = ble_sw_init(&param);
if (status != BLE_ERR_NO_ERROR)
  wlerr("ERROR: ble_sw_init failed: %d\n", status);
  return -EIO;
```
这个有错误检查，但 `wlerr` 可能输出到 syslog 而不是串口，需要确认日志是否可见。

#### 5. **Coexistence 配置问题**

BLE 和 WiFi 共享射频。`CFG_COEX` 宏的定义取决于 SDK 构建配置。如果共存未正确配置，WiFi 的射频活动可能完全阻塞 BLE 广播。

---

### ✅ 排查步骤

**第一步：确认 BLE 是否初始化成功**

在串口 NSH 中执行后，检查启动日志是否有：
```
gdwifi: wifi_init done
BLE stack started
BLE advertising 'NuttX'
```

如果看不到 `BLE stack started`，说明 `gd32_ble_initialize()` 根本没被调用或 `ble_sw_init()` 失败了。

**第二步：检查是否需要手动启用 `CONFIG_BOARD_LATE_INITIALIZE`**

在 defconfig 的 ble 配置中添加：
```
CONFIG_BOARD_LATE_INITIALIZE=y
```
或者确认 `CONFIG_BOARDCTL=y` 存在（让 NSH 的 `boardctl(BOARDIOC_INIT, ...)` 触发 `board_app_initialize()` → `gd32_bringup()`）。

**第三步：增加 BLE 任务栈大小**

在 `gd32_ble.c` 中修改：
```c
#define GD32_BLE_TASK_STACK      2048   // 从 1024 增加到 2048 words
#define GD32_BLE_APP_TASK_STACK  2048
```

**第四步：检查串口日志中的错误**

启动后在 NSH 中执行 `dmesg` 查看内核日志，查找：
- `ERROR: failed to start Wi-Fi`
- `ERROR: failed to start BLE`
- `ble_sw_init failed`
- 栈溢出的 `stack_check` 或 `assert` 信息

**第五步：验证 SDK 路径**

确认 `/home/maskmoo/GD32VW55x_WiFi_BLE_SDK` 目录存在且包含正确的 BLE 库文件（`libble_max.a`）。

---

### 🎯 最大概率原因

**最可能的是原因 1 + 2 的组合**：`CONFIG_BOARD_LATE_INITIALIZE` 未启用，同时 BLE 任务栈太小。建议先加上 `CONFIG_BOARD_LATE_INITIALIZE=y` 并增大栈，然后观察串口日志确认 BLE 广播是否成功启动。

---

## 🔎 nRF Connect 搜不到 BLE 设备 — 完整诊断

### 根本原因梳理

从代码来看，BLE 广播的逻辑链是：

```
NSH 启动 → board_app_initialize() → gd32_bringup()
  → gdwifi_start()           // 平台初始化（时钟/RF/NVDS）
  → gd32_ble_initialize()    // BLE 协议栈
       → ble_power_on()
       → ble_sw_init()       // 创建 BLE 任务
       → 注册 adapter 回调
       → [等待 ENABLE_CMPL_INFO 事件]
            → gd32_ble_adv_create()   // 创建广播集
                 → [等待 STATE_CREATE 事件]
                      → gd32_ble_adv_start()  // 开始广播 "NuttX"
```

### ⚡ 最可能的 3 个原因

#### 1️⃣ `CONFIG_BOARD_LATE_INITIALIZE` 未启用，`CONFIG_BOARDCTL` 也未设置

`common/defconfig:63` 中 `CONFIG_BOARD_LATE_INITIALIZE=y` 被注释掉了。此时 BLE 初始化走 `board_app_initialize()` → `gd32_bringup()` 路径，但这条路径需要 NSH 通过 `boardctl(BOARDIOC_INIT)` 触发。

**defconfig 中没有 `CONFIG_BOARDCTL=y`**，如果 NSH 没有调用 `boardctl()`，整个 `gd32_bringup()` 永远不会执行，BLE 也就永远不会初始化。

**修复：** 在 `configs/ble/defconfig` 中添加：
```
CONFIG_BOARD_LATE_INITIALIZE=y
```

#### 2️⃣ BLE 任务栈太小（4KB）

`gd32_ble.c:112-115`：
```c
#define GD32_BLE_TASK_STACK      1024   // = 4096 bytes
#define GD32_BLE_APP_TASK_STACK  1024   // = 4096 bytes
```

Vendor BLE host（GAP + GATT + SMP 全在 `libble_max.a` blob 中）在 4KB 栈上运行，栈溢出会导致 BLE 任务静默崩溃，广播永远不会启动。

**修复：** 在 `gd32_ble.c` 中增大栈：
```c
#define GD32_BLE_TASK_STACK      2048   // 8192 bytes
#define GD32_BLE_APP_TASK_STACK  2048
```

#### 3️⃣ WiFi 初始化失败 → BLE 平台状态不正确

## 🔴 核心问题：`wlinfo` / `wlerr` 宏未定义

BLE 代码 (`gd32_ble.c`) 使用了 `wlinfo()` 和 `wlerr()` 作为日志宏，但**在整个项目和 SDK 中都找不到这两个宏的定义**：

- `gd32_ble.c:242` — `wlinfo("BLE advertising '%s'\n", ...)`
- `gd32_ble.c:264` — `wlinfo("BLE disconnected ...")`
- `gd32_ble.c:508` — `wlerr("ERROR: ble_sw_init failed: %d\n", ...)`
- `gd32_ble.c:539` — `wlinfo("BLE stack started\n")`

而 WiFi 代码 (`gdwifi_glue.c`) 使用的是 `syslog(LOG_INFO, ...)`，所以 WiFi 日志正常输出。

这意味着两种可能：

### 情况 A：BLE 代码根本没编译进去

如果 `wlinfo`/`wlerr` 未定义导致编译错误，构建系统可能跳过了 BLE 模块。你的固件里实际上没有 BLE 功能。

### 情况 B：BLE 编译了但初始化静默失败

如果宏被定义为空（no-op），BLE 初始化可能在 `ble_power_on()` 或 `ble_sw_init()` 处失败/崩溃，但你看不到任何错误日志。

---

## 📋 总结：问题根因 + 已做的修复

### 根因

BLE 代码 (`gd32_ble.c`) 中使用的 `wlinfo()` / `wlerr()` 日志宏**在整个项目中未定义**。这导致：

- **编译失败** → BLE 模块没有被编译进固件
- 或者编译通过但宏展开为空 → BLE 初始化可能静默失败，你看不到任何日志

你的启动日志中完全没有 `BLE stack started` / `BLE advertising 'NuttX'` 也印证了这一点。

| # | 文件 | 修改内容 |
|---|------|---------|
| 1 | `chips/gd32vw55x/gdble/gd32_ble.c:76-81` | 添加 `wlinfo`/`wlerr` 宏定义，映射到 `syslog()` |
| 2 | `chips/gd32vw55x/gdble/gd32_ble.c:123,125` | BLE 任务栈从 1024→2048 words（4KB→8KB） |
| 3 | `configs/ble/defconfig:18` | 添加 `CONFIG_BOARD_LATE_INITIALIZE=y` |

<  *   to create the advertising set.

< #ifdef CONFIG_GD32VW55X_BLE_GATT_DEMO
< 
< /****************************************************************************
<  * Demo GATT service
<  *
<  * A minimal "transparent UART" service so a phone or PC can exercise the BLE
<  * data path: the central writes bytes to the RX characteristic (central ->
<  * board), the board logs them, and -- if the peer has subscribed -- echoes
<  * them back through a TX notification (board -> central).  16-bit UUIDs in
<  * the 0xffe0 vendor range, following the SDK app_blue_courier_link server
<  * model: the write is handled straight from the GATT server callback (which
<  * runs on the vendor BLE task) and the echo notification is issued from that
<  * same context, so the demo never re-enters the stack from a foreign task or
<  * work queue.
<  *
<  * Note: the write path is validated with write-without-response (a write
<  * command).  The prebuilt vendor controller does not reliably complete a
<  * write-request (write-with-response) or the CCCD subscribe that a Linux
<  * BlueZ host issues, so notifications are best exercised from a phone app
<  * such as nRF Connect.  See the board documentation.
<  ****************************************************************************/
< 
< #define GD32_BLE_SVC_UUID     0xffe0
< #define GD32_BLE_RX_UUID      0xffe1   /* central -> board (write)  */
< #define GD32_BLE_TX_UUID      0xffe2   /* board -> central (notify) */
< #define GD32_BLE_GATT_MAXLEN  244
< 
< enum
< {
<   GD32_BLE_IDX_SVC,
<   GD32_BLE_IDX_CHAR_RX,
<   GD32_BLE_IDX_RX,
<   GD32_BLE_IDX_CHAR_TX,
<   GD32_BLE_IDX_TX,
<   GD32_BLE_IDX_TX_CCCD,
<   GD32_BLE_IDX_NUM
< };
< 
< static const ble_gatt_attr_desc_t g_gatt_db[GD32_BLE_IDX_NUM] =
< {
<   [GD32_BLE_IDX_SVC]     = { UUID_16BIT_TO_ARRAY(BLE_GATT_DECL_PRIMARY_SERVICE),
<                              PROP(RD), 0 },
<   [GD32_BLE_IDX_CHAR_RX] = { UUID_16BIT_TO_ARRAY(BLE_GATT_DECL_CHARACTERISTIC),
<                              PROP(RD), 0 },
<   [GD32_BLE_IDX_RX]      = { UUID_16BIT_TO_ARRAY(GD32_BLE_RX_UUID),
<                              PROP(WR) | PROP(WC), GD32_BLE_GATT_MAXLEN },
<   [GD32_BLE_IDX_CHAR_TX] = { UUID_16BIT_TO_ARRAY(BLE_GATT_DECL_CHARACTERISTIC),
<                              PROP(RD), 0 },
<   [GD32_BLE_IDX_TX]      = { UUID_16BIT_TO_ARRAY(GD32_BLE_TX_UUID),
<                              PROP(NTF), GD32_BLE_GATT_MAXLEN },
<   [GD32_BLE_IDX_TX_CCCD] = { UUID_16BIT_TO_ARRAY(BLE_GATT_DESC_CLIENT_CHAR_CFG),
<                              PROP(RD) | PROP(WR),
<                              OPT(NO_OFFSET) | sizeof(uint16_t) },
< };
< 
< static uint8_t  g_gatt_svc_id;
< static uint16_t g_gatt_tx_cccd;   /* != 0 once the peer enables notifications */
< 
< /****************************************************************************
<  * Name: gd32_ble_gatts_cb
<  *
<  * Description:
<  *   Server events.  A write to the RX characteristic is logged and echoed
<  *   back through a TX notification; a write to the TX client-config
<  *   descriptor toggles notifications.  No explicit read/write confirm is
<  *   used: the stack auto-confirms from the callback return value and serves
<  *   descriptor reads from its own storage (SDK courier_link model).
<  *
<  ****************************************************************************/
< 
< static ble_status_t gd32_ble_gatts_cb(ble_gatts_msg_info_t *info)
< {
<   ble_gatts_op_info_t *op;
<   ble_gatts_write_req_t *w;
< 
<   if (info->srv_msg_type != BLE_SRV_EVT_GATT_OPERATION)
<     {
<       return BLE_ERR_NO_ERROR;
<     }
< 
<   op = &info->msg_data.gatts_op_info;
< 
<   if (op->gatts_op_sub_evt != BLE_SRV_EVT_WRITE_REQ)
<     {
<       return BLE_ERR_NO_ERROR;
<     }
< 
<   w = &op->gatts_op_data.write_req;
< 
<   if (w->att_idx == GD32_BLE_IDX_RX)
<     {
<       syslog(LOG_INFO, "BLE RX (%u): %.*s\n", w->val_len,
<              (int)w->val_len, (const char *)w->p_val);
< 
<       /* Echo the bytes straight back through a TX notification, from this
<        * same BLE-task context, if the peer has subscribed.
<        */
< 
<       if (g_gatt_tx_cccd != 0)
<         {
<           ble_gatts_ntf_ind_send(op->conn_idx, g_gatt_svc_id,
<                                  GD32_BLE_IDX_TX, w->p_val, w->val_len,
<                                  BLE_GATT_NOTIFY);
<         }
<     }
<   else if (w->att_idx == GD32_BLE_IDX_TX_CCCD &&
<            w->val_len == sizeof(uint16_t))
<     {
<       g_gatt_tx_cccd = (uint16_t)(w->p_val[0] | (w->p_val[1] << 8));
<     }
< 
<   return BLE_ERR_NO_ERROR;
< }
< 
< /****************************************************************************
<  * Name: gd32_ble_gatts_add
<  *
<  * Description:
<  *   Register the demo service.  Called once the host is up (after
<  *   ble_sw_init).
<  *
<  ****************************************************************************/
< 
< static void gd32_ble_gatts_add(void)
< {
<   uint8_t svc_uuid[BLE_GATT_UUID_128_LEN] =
<       UUID_16BIT_TO_ARRAY(GD32_BLE_SVC_UUID);
< 
<   ble_gatts_svc_add(&g_gatt_svc_id, svc_uuid, 0, 0, g_gatt_db,
<                     GD32_BLE_IDX_NUM, gd32_ble_gatts_cb);
< }
<

<  * Public Functions
<  ****************************************************************************/

< /****************************************************************************
<  * Name: gd32_ble_initialize
<  *
<  * Description:
<  *   Bring the BLE controller and the vendor host up, and start advertising.
<  *   Depends on the Wi-Fi platform bring-up (gdwifi_start): clocks, RF, TRNG
<  *   and NVDS are shared, and coexistence lives inside the blobs.
<  *
<  ****************************************************************************/
< 
< int gd32_ble_initialize(void)
< {
<   static ble_os_api_t os_api =
<     {
<       .os_malloc                  = sys_malloc,
<       .os_calloc                  = sys_calloc,
<       .os_mfree                   = sys_mfree,
<       .os_memset                  = sys_memset,
<       .os_memcpy                  = sys_memcpy,
<       .os_memcmp                  = sys_memcmp,
<       .os_task_create             = sys_task_create,
<       .os_task_init_notification  = sys_task_init_notification,
<       .os_task_wait_notification  = sys_task_wait_notification,
<       .os_task_notify             = sys_task_notify,
<       .os_task_delete             = sys_task_delete,
<       .os_ms_sleep                = sys_ms_sleep,
<       .os_current_task_handle_get = sys_current_task_handle_get,
<       .os_queue_init              = sys_queue_init,
<       .os_queue_free              = sys_queue_free,
<       .os_queue_write             = sys_queue_write,
<       .os_queue_read              = sys_queue_read,
<       .os_random_bytes_get        = sys_random_bytes_get,
<     };
< 
<   ble_init_param_t param;
<   ble_status_t status;
< 
<   memset(&param, 0, sizeof(param));
< 
<   /* Mandatory order: power on -> ble_sw_init -> callbacks -> IRQs */
< 
<   ble_power_on();
< 
<   param.role                    = BLE_GAP_ROLE_PERIPHERAL;
<   param.ble_task_stack_size     = GD32_BLE_TASK_STACK;
<   param.ble_task_priority       = GD32_BLE_TASK_PRIO;
<   param.ble_app_task_stack_size = GD32_BLE_APP_TASK_STACK;
<   param.ble_app_task_priority   = GD32_BLE_APP_TASK_PRIO;
<   param.en_cfg                  = 0;
<   param.p_os_api                = &os_api;
<   param.p_hci_uart_func         = NULL;  /* internal host, no HCI transport */
< 
<   status = ble_sw_init(&param);
<   if (status != BLE_ERR_NO_ERROR)
<     {
<       wlerr("ERROR: ble_sw_init failed: %d\n", status);
<       return -EIO;
<     }
< 
<   ble_adp_callback_register(gd32_ble_adp_evt_handler);
< 
<   /* Restart advertising when a central disconnects */
< 
<   ble_conn_callback_register(gd32_ble_conn_evt_handler);
< 
< #ifdef CONFIG_GD32VW55X_BLE_GATT_DEMO
<   /* Register the demo GATT service (RX write / TX notify) */
< 
<   gd32_ble_gatts_add();
< #endif
< 
<   /* Attach the radio handlers before enabling the sources in the ECLIC */
< 
<   gd32_ble_irq_attach();
< 
<   ble_irq_enable();                 /* only after ble_sw_init */
< 
< #ifdef CFG_COEX
<   /* Coexistence: the BLE scheduler (libble) tells the MAC (libwifi) about
<    * every radio window.  Both sides are already in the blobs; only the
<    * registration is ours.
<    */
< 
<   ble_coex_evt_notify_register(coex_ble_event_notify);
< #endif
< 
<   wlinfo("BLE stack started\n");
<   return OK;
< }

## 修复解释

### 问题根因：竞态条件

```
时间线（原始代码）：

gd32_ble_initialize()          BLE_task（新建）
    │                              │
    ├─ ble_power_on()              │
    ├─ ble_sw_init() ──────────► 创建 BLE 任务
    │   │                          │
    │   │  ← 此处调度器已运行 ──►  BLE_task 被调度执行
    │   │                          ├─ 初始化完成
    │   │                          ├─ 发出 BLE_ADP_EVT_ENABLE_CMPL_INFO 事件
    │   │                          └─ 但回调还没注册！事件丢失 ✗
    │   │
    ├─ ble_adp_callback_register()  ← 注册回调，但事件已经丢了
    └─ ...
```

Vendor SDK 的 iBeacon 示例不会遇到这个问题，因为 FreeRTOS 的调度器在 `ble_init()` 返回后才通过 `sys_os_start()` 启动，BLE 任务在回调注册之前不会被调度。

### 修复方案：sched_lock()

```
时间线（修复后）：

gd32_ble_initialize()          BLE_task（新建）
    │                              │
    ├─ ble_power_on()              │
    ├─ sched_lock()  ────────► 锁定调度器
    ├─ ble_sw_init() ──────────► 创建 BLE 任务
    │                              │ （被阻塞，不能运行）
    ├─ ble_adp_callback_register() │
    ├─ ble_conn_callback_register()│
    ├─ sched_unlock() ────────► 解锁调度器
    │                              │
    │                              ├─ 现在才被调度执行
    │                              ├─ 发出 BLE_ADP_EVT_ENABLE_CMPL_INFO
    │                              └─ 回调已注册，事件被正确处理 ✓
    └─ ...
```

`sched_lock()` 让当前任务保持运行，不让其他任务抢占。BLE 任务虽然已经被 `ble_sw_init()` 创建了，但要等 `sched_unlock()` 之后才能被调度。这样回调注册和 BLE 任务执行之间就不存在竞态了。

## 为什么 BLE PMU 唤醒需要 ~10 秒

看 `ble_pmu_config(1)` 的逻辑：

```c
void ble_pmu_config(uint32_t enable)
{
    if (enable) {
        if (pmu_flag_get(PMU_FLAG_BLE_SLEEP) == SET)   // ① 检查 BLE 是否在睡眠
            pmu_ble_control(PMU_BLE_WAKE);              // ② 发送唤醒命令
        while (pmu_flag_get(PMU_FLAG_BLE_ACTIVE) != SET); // ③ 等待 active 标志
    }
}
```

卡在第 ③ 步。可能的原因：

**1. 电源域时序依赖**

BLE 有独立的 PMU 电源域。复位后 BLE PMU 处于 sleep 状态，`pmu_ble_control(PMU_BLE_WAKE)` 发送唤醒命令后，硬件内部需要完成：
- BLE 电源域上电稳定
- BLE 时钟树锁定
- BLE 射频校准

这些步骤可能依赖 RF 电源域（WiFi 初始化时已开启的 `rf_power_on()`）完全稳定后才能进行。复位后 RF 需要重新校准，BLE PMU 要等这个过程完成。

**2. 复位残留状态**

WiFi 初始化中有 `wifi_power_off()` → `wifi_power_on()` 的电源循环来清除残留状态：
```c
GDWIFI_STEP("wifi_power_off", wifi_power_off());  // 清除残留
GDWIFI_STEP("wifi_power_on", wifi_power_on());
```
但 BLE 侧没有类似的电源循环。如果复位后 BLE PMU 处于一个**非 sleep 也非 active 的中间状态**：
- `PMU_FLAG_BLE_SLEEP` 不为 SET → 不发送唤醒命令
- `PMU_FLAG_BLE_ACTIVE` 也不为 SET → 永远等不到

需要等到硬件自行超时回到 sleep 状态后，再重新唤醒，这个过程可能正好需要 ~10 秒。

**3. 为什么是概率性的**

复位时 BLE PMU 的初始状态取决于复位前的状态：
- 如果复位前 BLE 处于 sleep → 复位后可能直接可唤醒（快）
- 如果复位前 BLE 处于 active 或中间态 → 复位后需要先回到 sleep 再唤醒（慢）

#### BLE 已知问题

**1. 硬件复位后 BLE PMU 唤醒慢（~10 秒）**

硬件复位后，系统可能在 `gdwifi: wifi_init done` 之后卡住约 10 秒才进入 NSH。

根因：`ble_power_on()` → `ble_pmu_config(1)` 中 `while (pmu_flag_get(PMU_FLAG_BLE_ACTIVE) != SET)` 等待 BLE PMU 进入 active 状态，硬件复位后该标志置位较慢。BLE PMU 电源域的唤醒依赖 RF 时钟稳定，而 WiFi 初始化（`gdwifi_start()`）中的 RF 上电/校准流程可能影响 BLE PMU 的响应时间。

状态：待排查。可能需要在 `ble_power_on()` 之前插入 BLE PMU 电源循环（类似 WiFi 的 `wifi_power_off()` → `wifi_power_on()`），或调整 BLE 初始化时序。

**2. BLE 广播回调竞态条件（已修复）**

原代码中 `ble_adp_callback_register()` 在 `ble_sw_init()` 之后调用，但 NuttX 调度器已在运行，`ble_sw_init()` 创建的 BLE 任务可能立即执行并发出 `BLE_ADP_EVT_ENABLE_CMPL_INFO` 事件，此时回调尚未注册，导致事件丢失，广播永远不启动。

修复：用 `sched_lock()` / `sched_unlock()` 包裹 `ble_sw_init()` + 回调注册，确保 BLE 任务在回调就绪后才能被调度。见 `chips/gd32vw55x/gdble/gd32_ble.c`。

从 NuttX 启动流程来看，答案是**不行**。让我解释原因：

## NuttX 启动顺序

```
nx_start()
  ├─ OS 数据结构初始化
  ├─ nx_idle_task_initialize()    ← 创建 IDLE 任务
  ├─ nx_smp_start()              ← 调度器在此启动（至少 IDLE 任务已就绪）
  ├─ board_early_initialize()     ← 最早期硬件初始化（时钟、GPIO）
  ├─ up_initialize()              ← 中断、定时器、串口等
  ├─ board_late_initialize()      ← 板级外设初始化（你的 gd32_bringup 在这里）
  └─ nx_bringup()                ← 创建 init 任务（nsh_main）
```

`board_late_initialize()` 被调用时，**调度器已经在运行了**（IDLE 任务已创建并就绪）。所以 `ble_sw_init()` 创建 BLE 任务后，该任务**立即可以被调度**。

## 为什么没有更早的钩子

| 钩子 | 调度器状态 | 能用吗 |
|------|-----------|--------|
| `board_early_initialize()` | 未启动 | ✗ 太早，RF/时钟/PMU 还没初始化 |
| `up_initialize()` 中间 | 刚启动 | ✗ 不是标准钩子，改不了 |
| `board_late_initialize()` | 已启动 | ✗ 调度器在跑，BLE 任务可被立即调度 |
| `board_app_initialize()` | 已启动 | ✗ 同上 |

BLE 初始化依赖 WiFi 平台（RF、时钟、NVDS），必须在 `gdwifi_start()` 之后执行。而 `gdwifi_start()` 在 `board_late_initialize()` → `gd32_bringup()` 中调用，此时调度器已经启动了。

## `sched_lock()` 是正确的做法

`sched_lock()` 是 NuttX 标准的调度抑制机制，专门用于解决这类"创建任务但还没准备好让它运行"的场景。它的开销很小（只禁止任务切换，不关中断），而且是暂时的——回调注册完就立即 `sched_unlock()`。

Vendor SDK 不需要这个是因为 FreeRTOS 的调度器在 `sys_os_start()` 才启动，所有初始化都在调度器启动之前完成。NuttX 的调度器启动更早，所以需要 `sched_lock()` 来弥补这个差异。

这意味着调度器**还没启动**。理论上可以把 BLE 初始化移到这里来解决竞态。但有依赖问题：

```
board_early_initialize()     ← 调度器未启动 ✓ 竞态条件不存在
  │
  │  但 BLE 依赖 WiFi 平台初始化（RF、时钟、NVDS）
  │  而 WiFi 在 board_late_initialize() 里才做
  │
board_late_initialize()      ← 调度器已启动
  ├─ gdwifi_start()          ← RF、时钟、NVDS 初始化
  └─ gd32_ble_initialize()   ← BLE 依赖上面的结果
```

要放到 `board_early_initialize()`，需要把 `gdwifi_start()`（或至少 RF/平台部分）也一起提前。但 WiFi SDK 的初始化流程比较重（DMA、NVDS、wifi_init 等），放到 idle 任务前执行是否安全需要验证。

`gdwifi_start()` 里的这些步骤是否都能在调度器启动前运行：

```
sys_os_init()          ← OS 封装层初始化，可能需要任务上下文
systick_init()         ← 硬件初始化 ✓
rom_init()             ← 硬件初始化 ✓
dma_config()           ← 硬件初始化 ✓
sysctrl_init()         ← 硬件初始化 ✓
rf_power_on()          ← 硬件初始化 ✓
wifi_power_on()        ← 硬件初始化 ✓
nvds_flash_internal_init() ← Flash 操作，可能需要调度器
wifi_init()            ← 创建 WiFi 任务 ✗ 需要调度器
```

`wifi_init()` 内部会创建 WiFi 任务（`WiFi_core_task`、`wifi_mgmt` 等），这些任务需要调度器运行才能执行。如果在 `board_early_initialize()` 中调用，WiFi 任务会被创建但不会被调度，直到调度器启动。

**所以答案是：可以尝试，但需要验证 `wifi_init()` 在无调度器环境下是否安全。** 如果你愿意试，可以把 `gdwifi_start()` + `gd32_ble_initialize()` 都移到 `board_early_initialize()`，去掉 `sched_lock()`，看 WiFi 和 BLE 任务是否都能正常工作。要试吗？

## 为什么可以

`gd32_bringup()` 里的初始化都是**创建任务/注册驱动**，不会等任务执行完才返回：

```
gdwifi_start()
  ├─ rf_power_on()           ← 纯硬件操作 ✓
  ├─ wifi_init()             ← 创建 WiFi 任务后返回，不等任务运行 ✓
  └─ return

gd32_ble_initialize()
  ├─ ble_power_on()          ← 纯硬件操作 ✓
  ├─ ble_sw_init()           ← 创建 BLE 任务后返回 ✓
  ├─ ble_adp_callback_register() ← 注册回调 ✓
  └─ return

I2C/SPI/ADC/PWM/LED/...     ← 注册驱动，不创建任务 ✓
procfs/LittleFS mount        ← 文件系统操作 ✓
```

任务创建后只是加入就绪队列，要等 `sched_unlock()`（`nx_start.c:836`）之后调度器才会调度它们。时序：

```
nx_start() [IDLE 线程, lockcount=1]
  ├─ board_early_initialize()     ← 调度器锁定
  │   └─ gd32_bringup()
  │       ├─ gdwifi_start()       ← WiFi 任务创建，加入队列
  │       ├─ gd32_ble_initialize() ← BLE 任务创建，加入队列
  │       └─ 回调已注册 ✓
  │
  ├─ nx_bringup()                 ← 创建 AppBringUp 任务
  │
  └─ sched_unlock()               ← lockcount=0，调度器启动
      │
      ├─ WiFi 任务开始运行
      ├─ BLE 任务开始运行 → 回调已就绪 → 事件不丢失 ✓
      └─ AppBringUp 任务开始运行
```

## 但要注意

`gd32_bringup()` 里有些操作可能需要任务上下文：

```c
// gdwifi_start() 中
sys_os_init();          // OS 封装层初始化
systick_init();         // 硬件 ✓
wifi_init();            // 创建任务后返回 ✓

// 但 wifi_init() 内部可能用 sys_sema_init 等 OS API
// 这些在调度器锁定时是否安全需要确认
```

NuttX 的信号量/互斥锁初始化（`sem_init`/`nxmutex_init`）在调度器锁定时是安全的，它们不触发调度。`malloc`/`calloc` 也安全。

**风险点：** WiFi SDK 内部如果有 `sys_ms_sleep()` 或等待信号量的操作，会尝试让出 CPU，但调度器锁定时无法切换任务，可能导致死锁。

374	/****************************************************************************
375	 * Name: gd32_ble_gatts_cb
376	 *
377	 * Description:
378	 *   Server events.  A write to the RX characteristic is logged and echoed
379	 *   back through a TX notification; a write to the TX client-config
380	 *   descriptor toggles notifications.  No explicit read/write confirm is
381	 *   used: the stack auto-confirms from the callback return value and serves
382	 *   descriptor reads from its own storage (SDK courier_link model).
383	 *
384	 ****************************************************************************/
385	
386	static ble_status_t gd32_ble_gatts_cb(ble_gatts_msg_info_t *info)
387	{
388	  ble_gatts_op_info_t *op;
389	  ble_gatts_write_req_t *w;
390	
391	  if (info->srv_msg_type != BLE_SRV_EVT_GATT_OPERATION)
392	    {
393	      return BLE_ERR_NO_ERROR;
394	    }
395	
396	  op = &info->msg_data.gatts_op_info;
397	
398	  if (op->gatts_op_sub_evt != BLE_SRV_EVT_WRITE_REQ)
399	    {
400	      return BLE_ERR_NO_ERROR;
401	    }
402	
403	  w = &op->gatts_op_data.write_req;
404	
405	  if (w->att_idx == GD32_BLE_IDX_RX)
406	    {
407	      syslog(LOG_INFO, "BLE RX (%u): %.*s\n", w->val_len,
408	             (int)w->val_len, (const char *)w->p_val);
409	
410	      /* Echo the bytes straight back through a TX notification, from this
411	       * same BLE-task context, if the peer has subscribed.
412	       */
413	
414	      if (g_gatt_tx_cccd != 0)
415	        {
416	          ble_gatts_ntf_ind_send(op->conn_idx, g_gatt_svc_id,
417	                                 GD32_BLE_IDX_TX, w->p_val, w->val_len,
418	                                 BLE_GATT_NOTIFY);

420	    }
421	  else if (w->att_idx == GD32_BLE_IDX_TX_CCCD &&
422	           w->val_len == sizeof(uint16_t))
423	    {
424	      g_gatt_tx_cccd = (uint16_t)(w->p_val[0] | (w->p_val[1] << 8));

463	
464	int gd32_ble_initialize(void)
465	{
466	  static ble_os_api_t os_api =
467	    {
468	      .os_malloc                  = sys_malloc,
469	      .os_calloc                  = sys_calloc,
470	      .os_mfree                   = sys_mfree,
471	      .os_memset                  = sys_memset,
472	      .os_memcpy                  = sys_memcpy,
473	      .os_memcmp                  = sys_memcmp,
474	      .os_task_create             = sys_task_create,
475	      .os_task_init_notification  = sys_task_init_notification,
476	      .os_task_wait_notification  = sys_task_wait_notification,
477	      .os_task_notify             = sys_task_notify,
478	      .os_task_delete             = sys_task_delete,
479	      .os_ms_sleep                = sys_ms_sleep,
480	      .os_current_task_handle_get = sys_current_task_handle_get,
481	      .os_queue_init              = sys_queue_init,
482	      .os_queue_free              = sys_queue_free,
483	      .os_queue_write             = sys_queue_write,
484	      .os_queue_read              = sys_queue_read,
485	      .os_random_bytes_get        = sys_random_bytes_get,
486	    };
487	
488	  ble_init_param_t param;
489	  ble_status_t status;
490	
491	  memset(&param, 0, sizeof(param));
492	
493	  /* Mandatory order: power on -> ble_sw_init -> callbacks -> IRQs.
494	   *
495	   * board_late_initialize() runs in the AppBringUp thread with the
496	   * scheduler unlocked.  Lock the scheduler around ble_sw_init() and
497	   * callback registration so the newly created BLE task cannot preempt
498	   * us until the callback is in place.
499	   */
500	
501	  ble_power_on();
502	
503	  param.role                    = BLE_GAP_ROLE_PERIPHERAL;
504	  param.ble_task_stack_size     = GD32_BLE_TASK_STACK;
505	  param.ble_task_priority       = GD32_BLE_TASK_PRIO;
506	  param.ble_app_task_stack_size = GD32_BLE_APP_TASK_STACK;
507	  param.ble_app_task_priority   = GD32_BLE_APP_TASK_PRIO;
508	  param.en_cfg                  = 0;
509	  param.p_os_api                = &os_api;
510	  param.p_hci_uart_func         = NULL;  /* internal host, no HCI transport */
511	
512	  sched_lock();
513	  status = ble_sw_init(&param);
514	  if (status != BLE_ERR_NO_ERROR)
515	    {
516	      sched_unlock();
517	      wlerr("ERROR: ble_sw_init failed: %d\n", status);
518	      return -EIO;
519	    }
520	
521	  ble_adp_callback_register(gd32_ble_adp_evt_handler);
522	
523	  /* Restart advertising when a central disconnects */
524	
525	  ble_conn_callback_register(gd32_ble_conn_evt_handler);
526	  sched_unlock();
527	
528	#ifdef CONFIG_GD32VW55X_BLE_GATT_DEMO
529	  /* Register the demo GATT service (RX write / TX notify) */
530	
531	  gd32_ble_gatts_add();
532	#endif
533	
534	  /* Attach the radio handlers before enabling the sources in the ECLIC */
535	
536	  gd32_ble_irq_attach();
537	
538	  ble_irq_enable();                 /* only after ble_sw_init */
539	
540	#ifdef CFG_COEX
541	  /* Coexistence: the BLE scheduler (libble) tells the MAC (libwifi) about
542	   * every radio window.  Both sides are already in the blobs; only the
543	   * registration is ours.
544	   */
545	
546	  ble_coex_evt_notify_register(coex_ble_event_notify);
547	#endif
548	
549	  wlinfo("BLE stack started\n");
550	  return OK;
551	}

git commit -m "fix(gd32vw55x/ble): fix BLE advertising race condition and document known issues

BLE advertising was never starting because ble_sw_init() creates the
BLE task which can fire BLE_ADP_EVT_ENABLE_CMPL_INFO before the
adapter callback is registered. In NuttX, board_late_initialize()
runs in the AppBringUp thread with the scheduler unlocked, so the
BLE task gets scheduled immediately.

sched_unlock() to prevent the BLE task from preempting until the
callback is in place.

Also enable CONFIG_BOARD_LATE_INITIALIZE so gd32_bringup() is
called from board_late_initialize(), and document the BLE PMU
wake-up delay (~10s after hardware reset) as a known issue in
the board README.
